title: Reconstruct a rational number despite bad modular residues

source.citation: Janko Böhm, Wolfram Decker, Claus Fieker, Santiago Laplagne, and Gerhard Pfister, Bad Primes in Computational Algebraic Geometry, arXiv:1702.06920

translation.notes: The source changes the residue modulo 5 while retaining the modulo 7 and 101 data, giving 2711 modulo 3535. Two-dimensional Gauss reduction returns `(25,30)`, whose common bad factor cancels to `5/6`.
